blocks.title: dbx-pro — query 60+ databases from Astravia
blocks.description: Connect through the dbx CLI to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse and 60+ more. Manage connections, write SQL, browse schemas, and keep production writes behind a safety gate.

items.title: Connection manager
items.description: Sync connections from DBX Desktop or add them manually.

items.title: SQL editor + result grid
items.description: IDE-style editing with multi-tab queries and inline-editable results.

items.title: Table browser
items.description: Explore schemas, describe columns, and preview sample rows.

items.title: Safety gates
items.description: Writes and DDL are blocked by default for production databases.

items.title: MongoDB support
items.description: Legacy shell syntax plus write-safety policies.

items.title: Send to AI
items.description: Right-click a table to inject structured context into the AI conversation.

items.title: Install the dbx CLI
items.description: Run brew install dbx, or use the DBX Desktop app.

items.title: Add a connection
items.description: Sync from DBX Desktop or enter the connection details manually.

items.title: Run a query
items.description: Open the dbx-pro activity tab and press ⌘/Ctrl+Enter to execute.

blocks.content: Writes and DDL are blocked for databases detected as production. Enable them explicitly per connection when you really need to.
